entries.compensating_control: The affected wheel is confined to local model execution inside a digest-pinned, network-disabled CUDA runtime image; remote code loading is disabled for strict evidence production.
entries.reason: Torch 2.13 fixes the advisory and is used by the CPU and aarch64 runtimes, but PyTorch has not published a 2.13 CUDA 12.8 wheel; remove after the CUDA image moves to a tested backend with a fixed wheel.

entries.compensating_control: The CUDA image installs hash-pinned wheels only and never builds or distributes setuptools sdists; CPU, aarch64, build, CI, documentation, and release environments use setuptools 83 or newer.
entries.reason: The CUDA 12.8 Torch 2.11 wheel requires setuptools below 82; retain only this CUDA-runtime exception until an upstream-compatible pairing permits setuptools 83 or later.

entries.compensating_control: The maintained integration does not enable the LM Evaluation Harness response cache or consume SQLite cache files; it runs with network access disabled and repository-controlled arguments and inputs.
entries.reason: LM Evaluation Harness 0.4.12 still requires sqlitedict even when its optional response cache is unused; remove this exception when the dependency can be omitted or replaced.
